=
WITH return_counts AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.`returns`
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_counts AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS refund_count
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
),
exchange_counts AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS exchange_count
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.exchanges
    WHERE status NOT IN ('rejected', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY order_id
),
config_values AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN config_key = 'as_of_date'
            THEN TRY_CAST(config_value AS DATE) END) AS asof,
        MAX(CASE WHEN config_key = 'risk_score_escalate'
            THEN TRY_CAST(config_value AS BIGINT) END) AS risk_score_escalate,
        MAX(CASE WHEN config_key = 'serial_refund_threshold'
            THEN TRY_CAST(config_value AS BIGINT) END) AS serial_refund_threshold
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.config
)

SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.country,
    o.currency,
    o.item,
    o.sku,
    o.size,
    o.amount,
    o.status AS order_status,
    o.refunded,
    s.status AS ship_status,

    DATEDIFF(c.asof, CAST(s.delivered_date AS DATE))
        AS days_since_delivery,

    p.return_window_days,
    p.version AS policy_version,

    COALESCE(r.return_count, 0) AS return_count,
    COALESCE(f.refund_count, 0) AS refund_count,
    COALESCE(e.exchange_count, 0) AS exchange_count,

    pr.category,
    c.risk_score_escalate,
    c.serial_refund_threshold

FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders o

LEFT JOIN workspace.agentic_support.shipments s
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id

JOIN workspace.agentic_support.policies p
    ON p.country = o.country

LEFT JOIN workspace.agentic_support.products pr
    ON pr.sku = o.sku

LEFT JOIN return_counts r
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id

LEFT JOIN refund_counts f
    ON f.order_id = o.order_id

LEFT JOIN exchange_counts e
    ON e.order_id = o.order_id

CROSS JOIN config_values c

WHERE o.order_id = '{{ $json.order_id }}'
  AND o.customer_id = '{{ $json.customer_id }}'

SELECT
    pr.sku,
    pr.name,
    pr.color,
    i.size,
    i.stock_quantity,

    CASE
        WHEN :country = 'IN' THEN pr.price_inr
        ELSE pr.price_aed
    END AS price

FROM workspace.agentic_support.products pr

JOIN workspace.agentic_support.inventory i
    ON i.sku = pr.sku

WHERE i.stock_quantity > 0

  AND pr.category = :category

  AND (
      CASE
          WHEN :country = 'IN' THEN pr.price_inr
          ELSE pr.price_aed
      END
  ) <= CAST(:amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))

ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN pr.sku = :sku THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    price DESC

LIMIT 12
